text: [295] 24 chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu himavantaṃ pabbatarājaṃ padāleyya ko pana vādo chavāya avijjāya katamehi chahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu samādhissa samāpattikusalo hoti samādhissa ṭhitikusalo hoti samādhissa vuṭṭhānakusalo hoti samādhissa kallatākusalo 4 hoti samādhissa gocarakusalo hoti samādhissa abhinihārakusalo hoti imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu himavantaṃ pabbatarājaṃ padāleyya ko pana vādo chavāya avijjāyāti . #1 ma. yu. bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ rogo gaṇḍo . 2 po. saṅgo . 3 ma. yu. sabbavera ... . #4 ma. yu. kallitakusalo .
